title: LingBot-Map: Real-Time 3D Reconstruction from Live Video
description:
LingBot-Map turns any camera feed into a 3D map in real time. It processes video frame by frame, handles over 10,000 frames without drift, and runs at 20 FPS on a standard GPU. Free open-source alternative to Matterport.
